title: A Full Training Loop
learning_objectives: Train a classifier with a DataLoader, CrossEntropyLoss and an optimiser
Switch between train() and eval() and evaluate under torch.no_grad()
Record the loss per epoch and make training reproducible with a seed
entry_point: train_classifier(X, y, n_hidden=16, epochs=100, lr=0.05, batch_size=16, seed=0)
hints: Convert once: `X = torch.as_tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32)`, `y = torch.as_tensor(y, dtype=torch.long)`; seed before building the model.
Per batch: `opt.zero_grad()`, `loss = loss_fn(model(xb), yb)`, `loss.backward()`, `opt.step()`, `total += loss.item() * len(yb)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Use CrossEntropyLoss on logits and run zero_grad / backward / step for every batch.
Seed with torch.manual_seed(seed) before building the model and pass a seeded generator to the DataLoader.
Call model.eval() before returning; the last layer has max(y) + 1 outputs.
Record the size-weighted mean loss once per epoch.
